_: What this version of iRice is tested with. Software Update reads the version it's about to install, so an Arch update can be held back until iRice supports it. Packages: tools/packages.sh.

hyprland.why: The Lua config and the Liquid Glass plugin (hypr/plugin/irice-glass) are built against Hyprland 0.56.

quickshell.why: Built by iRice (~/.local/share/irice/quickshell), so Arch's quickshell updates don't affect it.
